name: torbox-gateway
description: Multi-tenant API gateway, key management and admin dashboard on top of the TorBox API

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run mock -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
